text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

words.gloss_range: vocative address opening the whole paternal speech
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) summons the sons before any command appears. The whole line is heard as direct paternal address: relationship opens the speech, then command, prohibition, and axiom unfold inside that address.

topics.headline: direct paternal vocative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin by summoning the sons into relationship before any command is issued.
topics.reason: The word table identifies a vocative particle, and the clause evidence keeps the following commands inside the address frame.

words.gloss_range: plural construct kinship address with first-person possession
words.root_gloss_range: building, sons, and constructed household; locally the vocative kinship noun is selected while the building field colors the addressees
words.prose: {{ar:بَنِيَّ}} ({{tr:baniyya}}) makes the addressees Jacob’s own sons before they become agents of the mission. Its plural construct and first-person suffix personalize the command, while the {{ar:ب ن ي}} ({{tr:b-n-y}}) building field lets the household appear as something Jacob has built and now sends after the missing brothers. The address also sits in a family-speech chain, including 12:5, 12:67, and 12:81, and it contrasts the filial opening with the closing moral people-class.

topics.headline: possessive filial address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mission is given to sons held grammatically as Jacob’s own, not to anonymous agents.
topics.reason: QAC marks a plural construct noun with first-person suffix under vocative force, so the address remains personal before it becomes operative.

topics.headline: built-household pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the household as something built and now sent into motion, while local grammar keeps the word as a kinship address.
topics.reason: The broader root field supports building pressure, but the local form is a vocative kinship noun rather than a build verb.

topics.headline: recurring family-address field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this address within a wider father-son speech field, including 12:5, 12:67, 12:81, and the contrast with 11:42.
topics.reason: The cited references license an inter-ayah family-address contrast without changing the local vocative parse.

topics.headline: family identity against moral peoplehood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sons framed between a family identity at the start and the warned moral people-class at the end.
topics.reason: The opening filial plural and closing people-class form a local discourse frame, and the boundary evidence links prior ignorance to commissioned agency.

words.gloss_range: Form I plural imperative of departure, with the search object carried by the next verb
words.root_gloss_range: going, passing away, removal, and the gold noun field; locally directed motion is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱذْهَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:idhhabū}}) is the first imperative: Jacob’s knowledge becomes outward commissioned movement. The verb itself carries no direct object here, so the next command supplies the search target. The broader {{ar:ذ ه ب}} ({{tr:dh-h-b}}) field of going, disappearance, removal, and value colors a mission that answers earlier loss and sale imagery, including 12:17 and 12:20, while the local Form I command remains directed departure.

topics.headline: commissioned departure before search
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob’s certainty becomes outward action: the sons must go before they can search.
topics.reason: QAC marks a plural imperative with no direct object; the next verb carries the search target, separating movement from investigation.

topics.headline: loss and value pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the command answer disappearance and sale imagery, while the actual Form I verb still means going.
topics.reason: The root family supports passing-away and gold associations, but the local morphology selects Form I motion rather than gilding or the noun gold.

topics.headline: retrieval command echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the going command reverse the brothers’ earlier going claim in 12:17 and resonate with dispatch scenes such as 20:42 and 12:93.
topics.reason: The cited rows provide concrete command and journey parallels while local syntax keeps this as Jacob’s mission command.

words.gloss_range: consecutive connector making the search a sequel to the departure command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the second imperative the immediate sequel to the first. The ayah orders the mission as go, then search, so the two commands remain joined without collapsing into one vague instruction.

topics.headline: ordered command hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that going and searching are ordered as route then investigation, not as two loose commands.
topics.reason: QAC marks a consecutive conjunction, and local clause evidence links the second imperative as the sequel to the first.

words.gloss_range: Form V plural imperative for trace-sensitive seeking and sensory investigation
words.root_gloss_range: sensing, felt contact, faint sound, and intensified perception; locally the mission is perceptual search, not illicit spying
words.prose: {{ar:تَحَسَّسُوا۟}} ({{tr:taḥassasū}}) turns going into intensified sensory search. The Form V command asks the sons to seek traces and faint signs; the root’s felt-contact and sound texture make the investigation concrete. Variant and contrast rows sharpen the boundary with spying, especially 49:12, but the canonical word keeps the mission in legitimate perception. The single complement then holds Joseph and his brother together as one search pair, with a limited perception-and-disbelief echo at 3:52.

topics.headline: intensive sensory command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hope become disciplined investigation: the command demands intensified trace-seeking by the same addressees.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form V plural imperative; the clause chain places it between departure and the anti-despair prohibition.

topics.headline: trace-sensitive perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that the search is for subtle traces, faint signs, and felt contact rather than merely obvious information.
topics.reason: The root and form evidence support sensory intensity and faint perception without turning the command into violence.

topics.headline: sensing not spying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish legitimate sensory seeking from the spying field prohibited in 49:12, while the canonical reading remains the sensing root.
topics.reason: Variant and contrast rows are useful for the boundary, but the local canonical form is the sensory root rather than the bodily spying root.

topics.headline: search pair and perception echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one sensory mission hold Joseph and his brother together, with a perception-and-disbelief echo reaching to 3:52.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement and coordination support a single search pair, and the cited 3:52 row licenses a limited inter-ayah perception contrast.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the topic or source of inquiry before the named target appears
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) introduces Joseph as the topic of inquiry rather than as the object of the travel verb. The preposition delays the named target and ties him to the sensory-search command.

topics.headline: topic-of-inquiry preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Joseph is introduced as the object of inquiry through a preposition rather than as a direct object of the travel verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase complement the sensory-search verb, so the target is delayed and governed through inquiry.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name in diptote genitive position, naming the first search target
words.prose: {{ar:يُوسُفَ}} ({{tr:Yūsufa}}) names the first target as a foreign proper noun with diptote behavior in genitive position. The addition-name pressure makes the loss scene feel oriented toward restoration and increase, while locally the word still functions as Joseph’s proper name and gathers the surah’s search arc toward him and his brother.

topics.headline: diptote proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Joseph named as a marked foreign proper noun whose form resists ordinary declension.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a foreign proper noun in genitive position, and the row family coherently explains its diptote marking.

topics.headline: addition name in loss context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an addition-name pressed into a scene of loss, while the local function remains simply naming Joseph.
topics.reason: Name-meaning pressure can color the loss context, but the local syntax uses the word as a proper name and search target.

topics.headline: Joseph search arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Joseph’s name gather the surah’s search arc and the paired target with his brother.
topics.reason: The local coordination with the brother and the broader surah profile support the search-arc topic.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining two search targets without merging them
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second target with Joseph. The particle keeps the two missing brothers together in one mission without merging their identities.

topics.headline: coordinated search targets
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Joseph and his brother held together as one mission while remaining two distinct targets.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the brother with Joseph under the same search complement.

words.gloss_range: singular construct brother with suffix referring to Joseph
words.root_gloss_range: brotherhood, kinship, companionship, and weak-root morphology; locally the singular brother of Joseph is selected
words.prose: {{ar:أَخِيهِ}} ({{tr:akhīhi}}) names the second target through Joseph: the suffix points to Joseph’s brother, not Jacob’s or the group’s. The singular construct narrows the search to that brother while the broader kinship field remains active. Together with the opening address to Jacob’s sons, the mission layers Jacob’s sons as agents and Joseph’s brother as the relation to be recovered. The phrase also answers earlier brother scenes, including 12:65, 12:69, 12:76, and 12:89, and contrasts the go-with-brother frame at 20:42.

topics.headline: brother of Joseph
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brother is grammatically routed through Joseph, not through Jacob or the group.
topics.reason: QAC marks a five-noun genitive construct with a third-person suffix, and attachment evidence coordinates it with Joseph.

topics.headline: singular kinship focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the search narrow from all brothers to one specifically identified brother, while broader fraternity stays in the background.
topics.reason: The local form is singular with suffix, so broader kinship-field rows survive as pressure but do not make the word collective.

topics.headline: brother-command echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the phrase answer earlier Joseph recognition scenes and contrast the go-with-brother frame in 20:42.
topics.reason: The cited rows give concrete references and the local suffix supplies the brother relation being compared.

topics.headline: layered kinship roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Jacob’s sons and Joseph’s brotherhood layered in the same mission rather than flattened into one kinship label.
topics.reason: The opening address and the coordinated target phrase create a local kinship network; wider prophet-people formulas remain only comparative.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle shifting from search mechanics to prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from the search mechanics to the discipline that must accompany them. The mission is not only movement and investigation; it is also a refusal to let despair govern the search.

topics.headline: pivot to hope discipline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from the mechanics of searching to the spiritual discipline that must govern the search.
topics.reason: QAC marks coordination, and clause evidence places the prohibition after the practical command sequence.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing the jussive despair verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) marks the next verb as a direct prohibition. The sons are not being described as despairing; they are being commanded not to enter that state.

topics.headline: direct prohibition marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the anti-despair line as a command, not a description of the sons’ current state.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as prohibitive and governing the following jussive verb.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural jussive prohibition against despairing from divine relief
words.root_gloss_range: despair as cessation of expectation; locally a forbidden act, not a fixed identity
words.prose: {{ar:تَيْأَسُوا۟}} ({{tr:tayʾasū}}) forbids the sons from closing expectation off from divine relief. The jussive plural form makes despair an act to refuse during the search, not a permanent identity. The root’s closure of hope is more specific than grief, and the command reverses the collapse at 12:80 while preparing the final despair-disbelief maxim.

topics.headline: plural anti-despair command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees despair forbidden as an act the sons must refuse while they search.
topics.reason: The prohibitive particle governs a second-person plural jussive, and the complement binds the verb to the divine-relief phrase.

topics.headline: closed expectation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes despair as the closure of expectation, not merely sorrow or grief, with 39:53 as a related anti-despair frame.
topics.reason: The root evidence and cited contrast with another despair root preserve semantic precision without changing the local verb.

topics.headline: crisis arc and disbelief field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command reverse the brothers’ 12:80 collapse and prepare the final despair-disbelief maxim.
topics.reason: Same-surah crisis rows and despair-disbelief cooccurrence rows fit the local repetition from command to axiom.

words.gloss_range: source-domain preposition binding despair to the divine-relief phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) binds despair to its source-domain: the sons must not despair from the relief that belongs to God. The preposition completes the prohibition frame before the construct phrase names that domain.

topics.headline: despair-domain preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that despair is construed as withdrawal from a named divine domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the complement of the despair verb.

words.gloss_range: construct noun for divine relief, ease, or breath-like opening under the preposition
words.root_gloss_range: relief, breath, rest, spirit, and wind-related branches; locally relief is selected while variant and scent pressures remain visible

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition that governs the first relief noun

words.prose: {{ar:رَوْحِ}} ({{tr:rawḥi}}) is the first relief noun, governed by {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and bound forward in construct to the divine name. Its {{ar:ر و ح}} ({{tr:r-w-ḥ}}) field gives relief a breath-like openness, and the same-surah scent return at 12:94 makes that payoff concrete. Variant and substitution rows still let Spirit, wind, mercy, and bounty press on the phrase, while the local wording selects divine relief and prepares an exact refrain.

topics.headline: first divine relief phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first relief phrase grammatically locked between the preposition and divine possession, ready for exact repetition.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as genitive under the preposition and as construct before the divine name.

topics.headline: breath-like relief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels divine relief as breathable opening and scent-like return, especially in view of 12:94.
topics.reason: The root field and same-surah scent reference support a concrete relief image while local grammar keeps the noun in the divine construct phrase.

topics.headline: spirit and wind boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register Spirit, mercy, bounty, and wind-adjacent pressures without replacing the local relief sense.
topics.reason: Variant and branch evidence broaden the apparatus, but the local consonantal and grammatical phrase selects the relief noun in construct with the divine name.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name as possessor of the first relief phrase
words.root_gloss_range: the divine-name field of worship, awe, and definiteness; locally it anchors relief as belonging to God
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) makes the relief specifically God’s, not generic optimism or human mood. As the genitive possessor in the construct, the divine name anchors the first relief phrase and links the anti-despair command to the surah’s divine authority field, including 12:37 and 12:67.

topics.headline: divine possession of relief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the hope is not generic optimism; it is relief specifically possessed by God.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the genitive divine name as the second term of the construct phrase.

topics.headline: divine-name continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the divine name continue the surah’s authority field, including 12:37 and 12:67.
topics.reason: The cited rows support a continuity note while local grammar supplies the construct relation.

words.gloss_range: emphatic introducer with pronoun of matter launching the explanatory axiom
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُ}} ({{tr:innahū}}) lifts the speech from command into explanation. The emphatic particle and pronoun introduce the following claim as a determinate matter: the prohibition rests on a general axiom about who despairs.

topics.headline: emphatic axiom launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speech lift from direct instruction into a grounded principle.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the emphatic particle plus suffix, and clause evidence treats the following sentence as explanation of the prohibition.

topics.headline: matter-pronoun elevation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun raise the following claim as a determinate matter, while referential possibilities remain secondary.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows the suffix as the governed noun of the particle, and the discourse function favors a pronoun of matter without excluding all referential nuance.

words.gloss_range: declarative negation preparing the exclusive exception
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins that axiom with declarative negation. It first denies despair generally, then leaves the exception particle to identify the only class to whom it belongs.

topics.headline: negation before exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the axiom begin by negating despair generally before the exception carves out the named class.
topics.reason: QAC marks declarative negation, and the later exceptive particle completes the restriction.

words.gloss_range: third-person singular indicative despair verb in the universal axiom
words.root_gloss_range: despair as ongoing diagnostic action; locally it shifts the direct prohibition into a general classification
words.prose: {{ar:يَيْأَسُ}} ({{tr:yayʾasu}}) repeats the despair root from the sons’ prohibition, but now as a third-person indicative predicate. The ayah moves from do not despair to no one despairs except the named class; the action is stated before the subject is revealed, making despair the diagnostic marker.

topics.headline: repeated despair verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same despair root move from second-person prohibition to third-person axiom.
topics.reason: The same root and complement recur with a shift in person and mood, making the later verb explain the earlier command.

topics.headline: diagnostic exclusive action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees despair become the diagnostic action that identifies the final class only after the action has been named.
topics.reason: The singular predicate agrees with the collective subject after the exception, and the negation-exception structure creates exclusive classification.

words.gloss_range: repeated source-domain preposition preserving the exact despair complement
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) repeats the same source-domain frame from the earlier prohibition. The axiom does not paraphrase the object of despair; it returns to the same prepositional path.

topics.headline: repeated prepositional refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact complement frame return in the axiom rather than being paraphrased.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the second preposition govern the second relief noun as complement of the axiom verb.

words.gloss_range: second construct relief noun repeating the object of despair in the axiom
words.root_gloss_range: relief, breath, rest, spirit, and wind-related branches; locally the repeated relief phrase defines the axiom
words.prose: {{ar:رَوْحِ}} ({{tr:rawḥi}}) repeats the divine-relief object inside the universal maxim. The same breath-relief field now defines what the disbelieving class cuts itself off from, and the 12:94 scent echo keeps that return-current concrete. The Spirit variant would make the whole axiom Spirit-focused, while the local output keeps the repeated relief phrase as the controlling sense.

topics.headline: second relief-object refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same divine-relief object carried from the sons’ prohibition into the universal maxim.
topics.reason: The phrase repeats the earlier preposition, construct noun, and divine genitive, so the axiom keeps the same object.

topics.headline: relief as return current
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the breath-relief image transferred into the classification of disbelief and return.
topics.reason: The second occurrence keeps the same noun while discourse rows connect it to divine relief and return imagery.

topics.headline: second Spirit variant boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can note that the variant pressure would make the axiom Spirit-focused, while the local output keeps the repeated relief phrase.
topics.reason: Variant evidence is relevant apparatus, but the local canonical phrase remains parallel to the first relief phrase.

words.gloss_range: second genitive divine name closing the repeated relief phrase
words.root_gloss_range: the divine-name field of worship, awe, and definiteness; locally it repeats God as possessor and source of relief
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) closes the second relief phrase with the same divine possession as the first. The repetition makes the command and the axiom depend on the same source: God as possessor of relief, carried forward from 12:86 into 12:87.

topics.headline: second divine possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the axiom reproduce the exact grammar of divine possession from the prohibition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence again makes the divine name the genitive possessor in the construct phrase.

topics.headline: boundary divine continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees God remain the anchor from complaint and knowledge in 12:86 into relief and axiom in 12:87.
topics.reason: Boundary rows explicitly connect the divine name across the ayah boundary while local grammar supplies the repeated construct.

words.gloss_range: exceptive particle completing the negation-exception restriction
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the negation-exception restriction. The reader waits until this pivot to learn which class alone is attached to despair of God’s relief.

topics.headline: exclusive exception pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits until the exception particle to learn which class alone is attached to despair.
topics.reason: QAC marks the exceptive particle, and the following nominative phrase supplies the excepted subject in the negation-exception construction.

words.gloss_range: definite collective noun as the excepted subject of the despair predicate
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, and peoplehood; locally the word names a moral people-class rather than an ethnic crowd
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-qawmu}}) supplies the excepted subject. Its definiteness and nominative role make the people the only grammatical doers of despair in the axiom, while the {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) standing field makes the class feel like a community standing together but defined by despair and disbelief rather than ethnicity or straightness vocabulary. The familiar disbelieving-people formula is specialized here by despair of divine relief, with parallels including 2:250, 10:86, 12:37, and 9:37.

topics.headline: excepted subject class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people noun bear the grammatical weight of the only despairing subject in the axiom.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as nominative subject after the exception.

topics.headline: standing collective moralized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a standing collective defined by despair and disbelief, while the local word remains a people noun rather than a straightness term.
topics.reason: Root evidence supports standing and communal posture, but the actual noun is the collective class modified by the final participle.

topics.headline: disbelieving-people typology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a familiar disbelieving-people formula specialized here by despair of divine relief, with parallels including 2:250, 10:86, 12:37, and 9:37.
topics.reason: The formula rows provide concrete references, while local syntax defines the class through the despair predicate.

words.gloss_range: definite active participle naming the disbelieving coverers as the closing class
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, ingratitude, disbelief, and expiation by covering; locally the active participle names an ongoing moral posture

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: people noun modified or explicated by the final participle

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirūn}}) gives the final people-class its moral name. The definite active participle agrees with {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمُ}} ({{tr:al-qawmu}}) and presents disbelief as an ongoing posture. The {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) covering image makes despair feel like covering over divine relief, and the closing maxim ties this posture to despair-disbelief recurrences such as 12:37, 5:3, 29:23, and 60:13.

topics.headline: definite participle class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final label as a definite ongoing human class locked grammatically to the people noun.
topics.reason: QAC marks a nominative active participle agreeing with the people noun as adjective or apposition.

topics.headline: covering-root closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels despair as a covering-over of divine relief, not merely as a private emotion.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports covering and concealment, and the local active participle plus restriction make that posture the closing class.

topics.headline: despair-disbelief typology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Jacob’s local prohibition become a universal rule tying despair to disbelief, with echoes including 12:37, 5:3, 29:23, and 60:13.
topics.reason: The cited rows align the final participle with despair-root recurrence and the tail maxim structure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperatives to go and investigate are followed by the doubled prohibition against despair.
baseline_models.mechanism: Departure, sensory inquiry, and refusal to sever expectation form one operating sequence. Divine relief is therefore not only awaited; it keeps inquiry mobile and repeatable when the sought persons are absent.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing passage supplies the outward movement that makes hope behavioral.
Sense-based apprehension makes the search answerable to perceptible evidence.
Following reports turns perception into an active information-gathering practice.
Severed expectation names the failure mode that would terminate the search.
Recovered ease and breath supply renewed capacity after exhaustion rather than a passive mood.

changed_reading.before: A general exhortation to travel and remain optimistic.
changed_reading.after: Hope is an investigative discipline: keep moving, sensing, and asking because despair would prematurely close the evidentiary process.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command to sense out the missing brothers is set against repeated divine rawh and the final covering root.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden motion, air, and scent form a family of low-visibility carriers, while covering explains how a real trace can be treated as absence. The ayah permits a reading in which divine relief becomes detectable through slight, mobile signs before direct encounter.

activation_trace.role: A faint sound or movement supplies the subvisual trace that inquiry must notice.
Moving air supplies a medium by which an unseen sign can cross distance.
Odor and its apprehension make remote presence available as a trace rather than a sighting.
Covering supplies the occlusion that can make latent evidence appear nonexistent.

changed_reading.before: Divine relief is an unspecified future outcome.
changed_reading.after: Divine rawh may already be in transit as a slight sensory carrier; hope means remaining receptive to traces that a covering posture would miss.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The father addresses his sons and sends them toward Joseph and his brother as a paired object of recovery.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sonship as derived structure, brotherhood as bond, and the return of a due converge on relational reconstruction. The search is not merely for two located bodies; it attempts to rejoin members whose separation has damaged the family's supporting structure.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts into a structure makes the addressed sons potential agents of rebuilding.
Lineage supplies the concrete family relation whose integrity is at stake.
A fastening bond renders brotherhood as a relation that can hold separated members together.
Deliberate targeting keeps the search directed toward the specific brotherly pair rather than a generic consolation.
Restoring a due to its holder supplies the reparative direction assigned to divine relief.

changed_reading.before: The sons are dispatched to locate missing relatives.
changed_reading.after: The still-implicated sons are commissioned to rebuild a severed kinship structure by returning its withheld members and bonds.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sense-seeking and doubled non-despair culminate in the description of a people marked by covering.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing category can be read functionally: despair becomes a collective perceptual posture that covers truth and therefore stops looking. Active sensing and covering are opposed operations, so disbelief is rendered here as foreclosure of possible evidence.

activation_trace.role: Perceptual verification supplies the open evidentiary posture.
Cutting off expectation converts uncertainty into a closed conclusion.
A human collective scales the perceptual failure from an isolated feeling into a shared stance.
Material covering models how signs are occluded from attention.
Blocking acknowledged truth supplies the epistemic consequence of the material cover.

changed_reading.before: Despair is prohibited because unbelievers characteristically feel it.
changed_reading.after: Despair itself performs a covering operation: it makes a group stop sensing and treat unresolved absence as settled nonexistence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene separates an accusatory public description from concealed inward knowledge and withheld disclosure. Against that split, the focus command becomes critical inquiry: trace the absent brothers without letting a circulated label function as the cover over what is actually known.

activation_trace.role: Attribution of theft supplies the public label that can substitute for investigation.
Inward concealment locates countervailing knowledge beneath the spoken surface.
Potential emergence clarifies what the explicit non-disclosure withholds from view.
Presentation by attributed qualities supplies the contestable surface account.
Report-tracing becomes the method for testing a public account against hidden information.
Covering names the danger of allowing description to occlude the concealed reality.

structural_cues: 12:77 orders accusation, inward concealment, non-disclosure, and a challenge to description within one scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed public speech and hidden knowledge; I infer that this split makes the focus search a test of labels against latent signs. A live alternative is that the split creates narrative irony without prescribing an investigative method.

changed_reading.before: Seek information about where the missing brothers are.
changed_reading.after: Investigate through the cover of an accusation, distinguishing circulated description from concealed but recoverable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier despair directed toward a human authority is followed by withdrawal into private counsel and one brother's refusal to move. The focus repeats the despair root but changes its governing horizon to divine rawh and immediately commands departure, reversing both the object and bodily result of despair.

activation_trace.role: Cut expectation from the human encounter supplies the failed precursor that the focus reworks.
Separation into an exclusive group marks the social contraction produced after despair.
Secret counsel narrows failed public action into an inward circle.
Non-departure embodies the immobility that follows the earlier cutoff of hope.
Renewed passage supplies the bodily reversal from withdrawal and fixity.
Restored capacity relocates expectation beyond the exhausted human negotiation.

structural_cues: The same despair root occurs in 12:80 before withdrawal and in 12:87 twice between an imperative to go and the divine source of rawh.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated despair with opposite motion patterns; I infer that changing the object of reliance causes the shift from contraction to renewed search. A live alternative is that the motion contrast is sequential rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: Do not repeat the brothers' earlier discouragement.
changed_reading.after: Transfer expectation away from an exhausted human channel toward divine renewed capacity, and let that transfer reverse withdrawal into movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers limit testimony to what they know, disclaim custody of the unseen, and direct inquiry outward to a town. This sharpens tahassus into distributed corroboration: hope does not license unsupported certainty but keeps the inquiry open across independent witnesses.

activation_trace.role: Presence with observation supplies the bounded basis of testimony.
Disclosure to a knower limits the claim to what has actually become known.
Hiddenness from sight marks the evidentiary boundary the speakers refuse to overstep.
Directed questioning externalizes verification beyond the original speakers.
An assembled community supplies a distributed field of possible corroboration.
Following reports gathers the bounded observations into a continuing search.

structural_cues: 12:81 distinguishes witnessed knowledge from the unseen; 12:82 then names external parties to be questioned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies epistemic limits followed by outward questioning; I infer that the focus imperative generalizes this into a corroborative search protocol. A live alternative is that the proposed witnesses only defend the brothers' prior report.

changed_reading.before: Hope encourages persistence despite incomplete knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Hope preserves epistemic discipline: admit what remains unseen, then widen the witness network instead of converting uncertainty into despair or certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Grief roughens the self, affects the eyes, and is held inward; it is then deliberately disclosed to God while knowledge is retained. The focus prohibition therefore does not suppress grief. It distinguishes grief that can be voiced and ventilated from despair that severs knowledge, motion, and expectation.

activation_trace.role: The seeing organ supplies the bodily site where prolonged grief becomes visible.
Inner roughness supplies the affective pressure without equating it with severed hope.
Holding breath and silence models grief kept under internal pressure.
Expressed complaint opens a directed channel for what had been held.
Disclosure of the inwardly concealed supplies the release mechanism.
Knowledge that remains disclosed to the knower prevents grief from closing the epistemic horizon.
Regained breath and ease render rawh as capacity restored after affective constriction.
Cutoff of expectation remains distinct from intense but communicable sorrow.

structural_cues: 12:84 moves grief into the body, 12:85 names its mortal risk, 12:86 directs complaint to God while asserting knowledge, and 12:87 converts that posture into action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constriction, disclosure, retained knowledge, and then command; I infer that directed disclosure creates breathing room for renewed action. A live alternative is that lament and search merely coexist without a causal link.

changed_reading.before: Do not despair means restrain sorrow and remain positive.
changed_reading.after: Sorrow may be severe, embodied, and voiced; what is forbidden is letting it seal the horizon of knowledge and action.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the search command, harm and inadequate trade goods meet a request for complete measure and unpriced generosity. This activates rawh as material and social restoration: divine opening can arrive through a human transaction that exceeds the depleted party's exchange capacity.

activation_trace.role: Deficit and injury define the concrete exhaustion requiring relief.
A severed portion of wealth supplies the insufficient exchange offered by the seekers.
Scant value sharpens the mismatch between what is carried and what is needed.
Completion without deficiency supplies the requested reversal of scarcity.
Measured food gives restored capacity a concrete distributive form.
A gratuitous financial due supplies the surplus beyond strict equivalence.
Returning a due aligns divine relief with restoration through the transaction.
Expansion supplies the increased room created by full measure and generosity.

structural_cues: 12:88 follows the focus command with a scene that moves from household harm and weak purchasing power to full measure and charity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scarcity, an unequal exchange, completion, and charity; I infer that this scene concretizes one channel of rawh as restored material capacity. A live alternative is that the transaction is only the occasion for recognition and does not specify rawh.

changed_reading.before: Divine relief is chiefly emotional consolation or eventual reunion.
changed_reading.after: Relief can take distributive form: depleted seekers enter a relation where full provision and generosity exceed what their own goods can purchase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from unrecognized identity and acknowledged error to removal of blame, protective covering of fault, and mercy. This places two coverings around the focus: kafr covers truth and closes hope, while forgiveness covers fault to protect persons and reopen relation.

activation_trace.role: Lack of a recognizable marker supplies the prior state in which identity and consequence remain ungrasped.
Missing the right course supplies an acknowledged, revisable failure rather than a final identity.
Withheld blame removes the social mechanism that would keep the wrong exposed and active.
Protective covering of fault supplies a reparative counterpart to truth-obscuring cover.
Tender mercy supplies the relational purpose of the protective covering.
Occlusive covering supplies the opposed operation that makes signs unavailable.
Blocking truth supplies the despair-producing direction of that cover.

structural_cues: 12:89-92 orders ignorance, recognition, confession of error, cancellation of blame, forgiveness, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two roots with materially related covering images and a recognition-forgiveness sequence; I infer opposite directional functions for the covers. A live alternative is that the lexical analogy is evocative but not causally operative.

changed_reading.before: The closing group is a fixed class excluded from hope.
changed_reading.after: The closing phrase diagnoses a truth-covering operation, while the following recognition and forgiving cover show an opposed operation that can reopen damaged relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father's impaired eyes precede a command that delegates sensing to his sons; a second departure then carries a material sign back to his face, restores sight, and gathers the family. The two imperatives form a relay in which kin become an extended sensorium and search culminates in repaired perception and assembly.

activation_trace.role: The affected visual organ supplies the perceptual deficit delegated across the family.
Repeated departure turns the first search into a return mission rather than a one-way quest.
A worn object becomes the portable material link between absent person and impaired father.
Directed placement transfers the recovered sign onto the site of failed perception.
Restored ocular seeing closes the sensory circuit opened by delegated investigation.
Joining dispersed members makes perceptual restoration culminate in social reassembly.
Joined structural parts allow the sons to function as extensions of a damaged family body.
Sense-based inquiry is the delegated function carried outward and then returned as sight.

structural_cues: The window moves from impaired eyes in 12:84 to delegated sensing in 12:87 and repeats the departure imperative in 12:93 before restored sight and family gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory loss, two departures, a transported object, restored sight, and assembly; I infer a closed kinship relay that extends the father's perception through his sons. A live alternative is that the repeated departure is logistical and the sensory sequence should not be systematized.

changed_reading.before: The father sends able sons to perform a search he cannot perform himself.
changed_reading.after: The family becomes a distributed sensory body: the sons carry perception outward, return a material trace, restore the father's sight, and rejoin dispersed members.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it renders rawh as a mobile sensory carrier rather than generic relief. It remains anchored in the focus command through faint-motion, air, and odor branches; downstream prose should present it as a branch-activated sensory possibility, not as a lexical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins active sensing to repeated rawh while the sought persons remain out of direct view.

activation_trace.role: Faint movement supplies a sign detectable before its source becomes visible.
Airborne motion supplies the carrier that traverses the distance.
Scent supplies a signature of presence that can precede visual proof.
Travel makes the seekers intercept rather than merely await the mobile trace.

changed_reading.before: Go and wait for eventual relief to become evident.
changed_reading.after: Go into the trace field: rawh may announce presence through air, scent, or faint motion before the missing persons can be seen.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This ecological model is branch-distant and should not be rendered as the verse's settled sense. It remains valid as an analogy because covering seed, enclosing fruit, hidden movement, and renewed leafing all attach to focus roots; downstream prose should qualify it as an image of latency mistaken for absence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes despairing cover to sensory search and twice names divine rawh.

activation_trace.role: Soil covering seed supplies a concealment that can hold latent growth rather than prove extinction.
A sheath around fruit supplies protective invisibility before emergence.
Hidden motion supplies the first detectable activity under the cover.
Renewed leafing supplies emergence after a season that looked terminal.

changed_reading.before: Covering means only culpable refusal to see what is present.
changed_reading.after: Despair can also mistake a covered, latent process for final absence; sensing attends to the first motion of a life not yet emerged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bodily image is form-distant because it activates an unusual branch of qawm. It remains anchored in the focus's named collective and is sharpened by the window's loss and restoration of sight; downstream prose should use it only as a diagnostic analogy for socially intact but inactive perception.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ayah names a qawm whose despair coincides with covering and opposes it to active sensing.

activation_trace.role: An intact eye with absent sight supplies the image of a collective whose apparatus remains but whose perception is inactive.
Covering supplies the mechanism by which intact capacity is prevented from seeing.
Active perception supplies the opposed operation that can reactivate the social sensorium.
The window's affected eye gives the collective image an embodied narrative analogue.
Restored seeing keeps the diagnostic image reversible rather than essentializing it.

changed_reading.before: The despairing people are simply an externally named unbelieving group.
changed_reading.after: They can be pictured as a social body with an intact eye but no operative sight: despair is covered perception, and the search rehearses its possible reactivation.

strongest_changes: The prior despair episode turns the focus into a reversal from human-channel exhaustion, withdrawal, and immobility toward divine renewed capacity and outward inquiry.
The grief sequence separates intense lament from despair: directed disclosure preserves knowledge and makes action possible without denying sorrow.
The repeated departure culminates in a material relay that restores sight and gathers kin, making the search both sensory and relational repair.
Recognition and forgiveness distinguish truth-obscuring cover from a protective cover that removes blame and reopens relation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaved less like a detached maxim than a compact protocol linking movement, faint-signal detection, affective ventilation, material provision, recognition, and kinship reconstruction. Its strangest live activations treated rawh as an airborne trace, cover as possible latency, and the despairing collective as an intact eye whose sight has gone inactive.
remaining_uncertainties: The scent, germination, and social-eye models are branch-supported analogies but remain form-distant and should not displace the stronger inquiry-and-relief reading.
The causal arrow from disclosed grief to renewed action is abductive; the packet also permits simple coexistence.
The opposition between kafr-cover and forgiving cover is structurally productive, but the shared material image may be analogical rather than an intended lexical linkage.
The family-as-distributed-sensorium model depends on treating the two departure imperatives as a closed relay rather than separate logistics.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sense-based searching operationalizes hope.** ح س س B002/B004 (sense awareness; actively seeking news), ي ء س B001, and ر و ح B007 (relief/ease) form a search–hope mechanism. I infer that trust in relief requires gathering traces rather than passive waiting.
2. **Despair is a covering of available spaciousness.** ك ف ر B003 (covering/rejecting truth) and ر و ح B009 (breadth/spaciousness), kept distinct from B007, allow an exploratory spatial reading: despair seals the field of possible relief. This remains anchored in the repeated `روح الله` and final `الكافرون`.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:88 brought the searchers back into Yusuf’s presence, and 12:90 made recognition the relief hidden inside their economic distress.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hope operationalized as sensory news-seeking.** `ح س س:B004` is actively tracing news by asking, listening, and looking; `ح س س:B002` is sense-perception. This imperative is paired with refusal of `ي ء س:B001`, loss of hope, and with `ر و ح:B007`, relief and breath returning after exhaustion. The packet supplies search and expected relief as distinct elements; I infer that hope becomes causally responsible by deploying the senses toward still-hidden persons. *Fataḥassasū* reads as the practical method by which non-despair enters the world.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:94 lets Jacob detect Joseph by scent before the caravan arrives, validating the sensory orientation of the search command through an unexpectedly subtle form of evidence.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi beş duyuyu ve bir şeyi duyu aracılığıyla algılayıp varlığını bilme, görme veya bulma sonuçlarını birlikte verir. Dal uygundur; ancak genel bilgiyi değil, duyusal temelden doğan bilgiyi anlattığı açık tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, duyu yetilerini yalın çekirdek olarak verir; bir şeyi algılayıp bilme anlamını ise nesneli kullanıma bağlı sonuç olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görme, işitme veya başka bir duyu yoluyla algılamak ve bu algı sayesinde onun varlığını bilmek. Beş duyu, bu algılamayı sağlayan yetiler bütünüdür.

facets.statement: Dış dünyadaki bir şeyi bir duyu aracılığıyla algılama.
Duyusal algıdan hareketle bir şeyin varlığını bilme, görme veya bulma.
Algılamayı mümkün kılan beş duyu yetisini topluca adlandırma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar beş duyu yetisini ve bu yetilerden biriyle bir şeyi algılayıp onun farkına varmayı aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duyu yetisini, algılama eylemini ve algıdan doğan bilgiyi kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal araç, algılama ve farkına varma bağını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne ya da durumun duyusal yoldan algılandığı anlatılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Algı ile bundan doğan farkındalık arasındaki bağı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onu duyuyla algıladı ve varlığını anladı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Beş duyu yetisini topluca adlandırır ve duyudan doğan bilmeyi açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Görme ve işitmenin yanında içte sezilen korkuyu ve bakıp araştırmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi görme, işitme veya duyma yoluyla fark etme alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algının duyu yetileriyle kurulmasına ve algıdan bilgi doğmasına dayanır; komşu dalın kapsamı içsel sezgiye ve araştırıcı bakışa da açılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görülmeden fark edilen iki ilişkili yüzü açıkça bildirir: işitilen hafif ses ve sesten bağımsız olarak duyusal biçimde algılanan gizli hareket. Verilen dal çerçevesi, hareketi zorunlu olarak sese indirgemeden okunduğunda bu çekirdeği doğru yansıtır.

error_profile.preserves: İşitilebilir en hafif hareket belirtisinin yokluğunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: görülmeden fark edilen hafif ses veya hareket

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da şiddeti düşük, zor seçilen bir sesi anlatabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem hayvanın bağlandığı halka veya bağı hem de gözetilmesi gereken dokunulmaz ilişki ve yükümlülük anlamını açıkça verir. İkinci anlam, fiziksel bağlama aracına eşitlenmeden, korunması gereken bağın soyut uzantısı olarak ayrı tutulabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad biçimleri hem fiziksel hem soyut anlam taşırken, bağlama eylemi yalnızca belirtilen hayvan bağlama yapısına özgüdür ve genel bir bağlamak anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir hayvanın tutturulduğu halka, bağ veya sabit bağlama noktasıdır. Aynı ad, gözetilmesi gereken dokunulmaz bir ilişkiyi, hakkı ya da yükümlülük bağını da belirtir.

facets.statement: Fiziksel anlam, hayvanın kendisine bağlandığı halka, bağ veya sabit tutturma noktasını belirtir.
Soyut uzantı, korunup gözetilmesi gereken ilişkiyi, hakkı veya karşılıklı yükümlülüğü belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar fiziksel adlandırmayı hayvanın bağlandığı halka veya bağ üzerinden açıklar ve çoğul biçimini doğrular. Aynı adın, korunması gereken ilişki, hak ve yükümlülük için kullanılan soyut anlamını da bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel bağlama aracını ve ondan ayrılan, korunması gereken soyut ilişki anlamını birlikte gösteren üst anlatım olarak uygundur.

tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
